text:
Lena Gomez: FYI Clearwave sent back the vendor risk form. They flagged SOC2 scope, DPA retention clauses, and requested evidence for access controls in nonprod. They want a consolidated reply by next Wednesday. Form: https://clearwave.example/vendorrisk.pdf

Nikhil Rao: Quick read-through : Do they expect policy text or samples of enforcement (logs, screenshots)?

Lena Gomez: They asked for both: control narratives + evidence examples where possible. For some items they said a remediation plan with owner & ETA would be acceptable.

Dana Kim: I'll take SOC2 control narratives and access control answers. I can draft short, plain-language responses and attach where we can sample redacted logs.

Maya Alvarez: I'll handle retention/DPA language and the embeddings question. Clearwave is specifically asking how long embeddings are kept and whether they can opt into a stricter retention schedule.

Nikhil Rao: Technical notes: hosted deployments use customer-isolated namespaces; nonprod has role-based access and no production data by default. Evidence candidates: `s3://evidence/clearwave/policies/`, `s3://evidence/clearwave/access-logs/` (redacted), and `s3://evidence/clearwave/embeddings/retention-matrix.xlsx`. If they want raw logs we must check with Legal.

Dana Kim: For the DPA retention clause, we should propose two options: 1) standard retention (90d prod, 30d nonprod cache) 2) accelerated retention (30d prod, 7d nonprod) for customers who require it. Call out cost and operational implications.

Lena Gomez: Good. Also they asked about subprocessor list and subprocessors inside the EU. I'll coordinate with Procurement for an updated list.

Maya Alvarez: Note: we do not currently offer customer-managed keys for hosted accounts. We can propose Dedicated or Private for BYOK. I'll draft that section and include migration estimate.

Nikhil Rao: If we suggest Dedicated as a BYOK path, include a note about data migration steps and estimated downtime (we should say near-zero if using blue-green but mention testing window of 2 business days).

Dana Kim: Timeline proposal: Mon morning  initial drafts in-thread; Tue internal review; Wed legal redaction; Wed EOD ship. Is legal okay with that schedule?

Lena Gomez: Legal usually needs 48 hours. If we want Wed EOD shipping, we need to get drafts to Legal by Mon EOD. Adjusting: drafts Mon AM, legal Mon PM-Tue, final Wed EOD.

Nikhil Rao: I'll prepare redacted query samples showing role IDs and truncated user IDs rather than full PII.

Maya Alvarez: Also ask Clearwave whether they need evidence about model outputs retention (we may need to state policy for retained prompts / responses if used for quality).

Dana Kim: Adding action split:
- Dana: SOC2 control narratives + access control evidence pointers (due Mon AM)
- Nikhil: Redacted logs + technical appendix (due Mon AM)
- Maya: DPA retention options + BYOK migration note + subprocessors list coordination (due Mon AM)
- Lena: Consolidate and submit to Legal (due Mon EOD)

jira-bot: Created ticket RDW-4299: "Clearwave vendor risk form response" assigned to @Lena Gomez, priority P2, due 2026-06-03.

Lena Gomez: Also collecting customer feedback ask: Clearwave included a short feedback survey about our onboarding docs. Please add notes on anything confusing you saw in their responses so we can send to Docs.

Maya Alvarez: They've flagged the embed retention docs as unclear. I'll draft suggested clarifications for our public docs.

Nikhil Rao: Heads up: Eng might need to run a query for historic embedding retention counts to produce the retention matrix. I'll add Eng tag in the ticket.

Dana Kim: If Legal requires an NDA amendment for raw logs, we should plan to send a partial package first with everything else completed. Call that out in the cover note.

Lena Gomez: Good call. Let's aim for partial if needed. I'll pull the consolidated draft into the workspace and ping Legal when it's ready.

Nikhil Rao: Uploaded draft snippets to https://internal.redwood.example/clearwave/drafts.

Maya Alvarez: Re: migration estimate for Dedicated: about 10 business days with tests, plus procurement lead time. I'll include a simple cost delta appendix.

Lena Gomez: Thanks team. We'll reconvene here if anything blocks. If Legal asks for further redactions, we'll prioritize retention and access controls first.

jira-bot: RDW-4299 status set to "Open".

Dana Kim: Posted draft Q&A in thread: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/clearwave-vrf-v1. Feedback welcome.

Lena Gomez: Closing note: Clearwave asked for a single ZIP with control narratives, evidence index (with paths), and the proposed DPA addendum. I'll assemble after Legal signoff.

Maya Alvarez: :white_check_mark: will add doc edits to the Docs backlog after we finalize wording.
